summary: Audit of phase_base 562c5800..audited_head 787e846d, focused on the remediation diff a12329d9..787e846d (spec 11ed8c05, Red 3206662f, plan 5bdf3075, Green 91b2a1ca, plan 787e846d). HEAD equals 787e846d. RA2-1 is fixed: classifyOutDir returns invalid for every path below the child folder cards except the exact card folder, and runGuards refuses a 5.00 USD cards/muse/elements row with exit 3 before any cost scan (live probe). CG15 is non-vacuous: Red ran it against the unfixed code and got 6 assertion failures with exit 1, and Green's MF4 mutation fails CG15 at 1 failed and 14 passed. RA2-2 is fixed: spec.md now states the cards skip and no longer claims card spend counts the restart cap. classifyOutDir keeps week, cover, elements of other children, and no-outDir specs as restart, and keeps the trailing-slash card path as card (probe). A3 and A5 hold: strict it( counts give N_new 30 and N_old 41 for a total of 71, which matches the plan claim and Green's log (6 files, 71 tests, 0 owned tsc errors, MF4 1 failed / 14 passed, restored 15 of 15). Two new Nits: spec.md still calls the RA2-1 fix pending (confirms Review B RB2-5, rated Nit), and CG15's not-contains-no-key assertion cannot fail with an empty HOME. Carried Nits RA-2, RA-3, RA-4, RA-6 are unchanged; RA2-5 and RA2-6 remain true and RA2-6 is worse because test-strategy.md still ends at CG11 and M7. RA2-3 and RA2-4 are withdrawn as superseded by Review B RB2-1 at this head. vitest not run by Review A round 3: heavy lock held by other projects.

The assertion does not prove that refusal happens before key access; the exit-3 and outDir assertions carry that claim. Strategy 4.7 row A4 names `The CLI test fails if no key shows` as a defense, and that line cannot trigger. CG15 as a whole stays non-vacuous because Red failed 6 of its assertions. | new in this diff for the CG15 instance; the CG13 and CG14 instances predate it. Disposition: note.
evidence: HEAD check: git rev-parse HEAD at the start gives 787e846d3afbc5e945b7d51eac28406a87833f15. It equals audited_head_sha and role_base_sha.

Scope: git log a12329d9..787e846d lists 11ed8c05, 3206662f, 5bdf3075, 91b2a1ca, 787e846d. git diff --stat names 4 files: track plan.md, track spec.md, scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs, tests/storytime-card-guards.test.ts. No orchestration script, registry file, or contract test changed.

RA2-1 closed by probe: classifyOutDir returns invalid for cards/muse/elements, cards/other/muse, cards/muse2, and w02/muse/../../cards/muse/elements. It returns card for cards/muse and for cards/muse/ with a trailing slash, restart for w01/muse, cover/muse and w03/muse/elements, and restart for a spec without outDir and for an undefined spec.

RA2-1 runGuards probe: with a 5.00 USD row in <root>/out/storytime/l2/unit1/cards/muse/elements/costs.tsv, runGuards returns refused true, code 3, run invalid, spend 0, message `refused: outDir out/storytime/l2/unit1/cards/muse/elements of l2-w04-card-mom is outside the scanned cost folders`. scanCostFiles on the same root reads 0 rows, so the refusal happens before any scan.

RA2-1 reachability stays closed: no file under docs/ names a cards/muse/elements path, all 31 card specs use outDir out/storytime/l2/unit1/cards/muse, and scanCardCostFiles still reads the elements cost file for spend, which CG8 pins.

A4 missing-deliverable fixture: Red 3206662f ran CG15 against the unfixed implementation and mid-red-11ed8c0.log records exit 1, `Tests 1 failed | 14 passed (15)`, with 6 assertion failures and no load error. Green's MF4 mutation (remove the cards guard line) fails CG15 at `1 failed | 14 passed (15)`, and the restored copy passes 15 of 15 (jr-green-5bdf307.log).

RA2-2 closed: spec.md Guard interaction now states that scanCostFiles skips the direct child folder cards, that the restart cap never counts card spend, and that the card cap never counts restart spend. The three false statements of the round-2 text are gone.

RA3-1 confirmation: spec.md:214-215 reads `review-a RA2-1, fix pending in the next Green round` at this head, although commit 91b2a1ca is an ancestor of HEAD. This confirms Review B RB2-5 and rates it Nit.

A3: strict it( counts at HEAD are guards 15, specs 10, fixtures 5, attempts 30, judge 8, stage 3. N_new 15+10+5 = 30, N_old 30+8+3 = 41, total 71. Plan.md uses labeled integers and correct arithmetic (30 prior 29 plus 1, 41, 71).

A5: plan.md round-4 gate claims `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 71 passed (71)`, `owned tsc errors: 0`, MF4 `1 failed and 14 passed`, restored `15 of 15`. jr-green-5bdf307.log states the same labeled values and exit 0.

Allowed set: the 4 changed files match the section 6 regex of test-strategy.md. Red 3206662f touched only tests/storytime-card-guards.test.ts. Green 91b2a1ca touched only scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs, and 787e846d touched only plan.md.

Contract types: scripts/storytime-muse-guards.d.mts already declares kind 'card' | 'restart' | 'invalid' and run 'card' | 'restart' | 'mixed' | 'invalid', so the fix needs no type change. classifyOutDir has one production caller, runGuards; the other references are the declaration file and CG13 to CG15.

Carried Nits RA-2, RA-3, RA-4 and RA-6: the four files they name did not change in a12329d9..787e846d (test lines 78 and 91, CG11 block, scripts/storytime-judge-batch.mjs, l2-w07-card-train.json). Each remains a read-only observation.

RA2-3 withdrawn: Review B RB2-1 at this head covers the in-pool re-check as a Major (up to 4 workers and 3 parallel line tries pass one re-check because logCall writes after the call returns), so the coverage gap and the line-tries granularity are part of that FIX disposition.
RA2-4 withdrawn: Review B RB2-1 names the same line-tries concurrency (`up to 3 parallel line tries per worker`) at this head, so this Nit adds no separate action.

RA3-2 check: HOME set to an empty directory makes homedir() return that directory and readFileSync throw ENOENT, whose message does not contain `no key` (probe: `err starts: ENOENT: no such file or directory`). A wrong guard order therefore still satisfies the assertion, while the exit-3 assertion fails.
